predecessors.name: Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic
predecessors.text: the Byelorussian SSR, which 'proclaimed the sovereignty of Belarus on 27 July 1990' and 'gained independence on 25 August 1991'

certainty.note: The frontiers are the former Soviet republican boundaries; the page dates the demarcation treaties with Latvia and Lithuania to 1995 and 1996 (final Lithuanian documents February 2007) and the Ukrainian treaty of 1997 to its ratification…
